notes:
When the coding agent saved something to memory, it could copy its own note ("[MEMORY-SAVED: …]") into a file it was writing for you. That note is now kept out of your files, and files that merely mention those words are left exactly as they are.

If the model was unloaded while the coding agent was in the middle of a task, the task could stop with no message at all. It now ends with a plain "The agent could not finish. Please try again.", and a request to unload the model while a task is running is refused until the task is done.

Apps using Outlier's local API (/v1) that set a time limit with max_wall_seconds now get their timeout when that time is up, even while waiting behind another request. Before, the error could arrive up to four times later.
